title: Commentary: the beauty and public appreciation of nature
content: The value of appreciating the aesthetic qualities of insects is highlighted by Wagner and colleagues in their elegiac Thinking of Biology article, “On the beauty of insects” (https://doi.org/10.1093/biosci/biag085). One of the coauthors is the deceased great scholar and mentor, Peter Raven, who was very actively involved with the American Institute of Biological Sciences over the course of many decades.
